news.title: Live @ NAOS — Athens
news.description: Tilt Guild perform live at NAOS alongside STRAiNGER and Kawaii Sharx.
news.title: Debut Album 'Το Κόλπο' Released
news.description: Tilt Guild, a DIY independent rap metal band from Athens, Greece, released their debut album 'Το Κόλπο' (The Trick) in November 2024, bringing a fresh and raw sound to the underground rap metal scene.
